defects.name: OWNER_AUTHENTICATION_FAIL_OPEN
defects.proof: An arbitrary fabricated owner id/version/hash plus arbitrary exact object/evidence/provenance refs can use the public compute_owner_binding_content_hash helper and is accepted as VERIFIED_OWNER_BOUND_INPUT.
violated_requirements: materializer verifies exact ownership before issuing a ref
malformed/unknown/unowned input fails before ref emission
defects.root_cause: owner_binding_content_hash is a self-consistency checksum over caller-controlled fields, not independently verifiable owner-authority acceptance/authentication

defects.name: ONE_OBJECT_SCOPE_ESCAPE
defects.proof: The exported stateless materialize_owner_bound_subject function emits distinct refs for objects A and B, and separate OneObjectSubjectRegistry instances each admit a distinct object.
violated_requirements: second distinct object is impossible at V1 grain
implementation does not silently widen into a general registry substrate
defects.root_cause: one-object cardinality exists only as mutable per-instance memory and is bypassable by the exported stateless materializer or by constructing another registry instance

derived_risk.synthetic_fixture_promotion: Because T2-D01 accepts fabricated owner bindings and T2-D02 permits unbounded distinct materializations, a caller can make synthetic/arbitrary bytes yield real-looking content-addressed subject refs. This is a consequence of D01+D02, not a semantic-parser defect.

smallest_repair_requirement.owner_gate: Require an independently verifiable accepted-owner authority snapshot/capability binding exact authority id/version/hash, governed object family/scope, and exact object/evidence lineage. A caller-computable owner-binding checksum may remain integrity evidence but cannot itself satisfy owner authentication.
smallest_repair_requirement.one_object_gate: Bind V1 materialization to one immutable content-addressed one-object permit/scope that names the exact expected owner-bound semantic object ref/hash. Remove or gate the unrestricted stateless export so a new process/registry instance cannot authorize a different object under the same bounded candidate.
smallest_repair_requirement.semantic_scope: No new entity semantics, classifier authority, encounter authority, or general world ontology is required for the repair.
